prompt: Based only on this recording, does this speaker show signs of dementia? Answer with one word, Yes or No.
command: cd /workspace/pod4 && HF_HOME=/workspace/hf python3 score_zs.py Qwen/Qwen2.5-Omni-7B bf16 man_cut.csv,out/o25_noinv_recording.csv,recording | ...  man_orig.csv,out/o25_orig_recording_rerun.csv,recording | ... man_orig.csv,out/o25_orig_voice.csv,voice  (one invocation per job, see run_o25.sh); then python3 finalize.py <name> (calls analyze.py spec_<name>.json)
bootstrap: speakers resampled with replacement, fresh numpy.random.default_rng(0) per cell, percentile 2.5/97.5; per arm: subset then resample; PAIRED: one speaker draw per replicate
p_yes: P(Yes)/(P(Yes)+P(No)) at the first answer position; paper id set (first token of Yes, Yes, yes, yes, YES / No, No, no, no, NO with and without leading space as in extract_probe_layers.py); p_yes_r3 column = rule-3 single-token set incl. leading-space YES/NO
